name: dynamsoft-barcode-reader-bundle
description: Dynamsoft Barcode Reader JS is a recognition SDK which enables you to embed barcode reading functionality in your web, desktop, and mobile applications. With a few lines of JavaScript code, you can develop a robust application to scan a linear barcode, QR Code, DaraMatrix, PDF417, and Aztec Code.

scripts.build-core: cd ../CORE && npm run build-bundle -- DBR CORE && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.build-cvr: cd ../CVR && npm run build-bundle -- DBR CVR  && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.build-dbr: cd ../DBR && npm run build-bundle -- DBR DBR && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.build-dce: cd ../DCE && npm run build-bundle -- DBR DCE && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.build-dcp: cd ../DCP && npm run build-bundle -- DBR DCP && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.build-license: cd ../LICENSE && npm run build-bundle -- DBR LICENSE && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.build-utility: cd ../UTILITY && npm run build-bundle -- DBR UTILITY && cd ../DBR_BUNDLE && npm run build-dev
scripts.makeZip: makeZip --package=dynamsoft-barcode-reader-bundle --version=auto --sampleBranch=_dev --structure=old --otherPkgs=dynamsoft-capture-vision-std dynamsoft-image-processing dynamsoft-core dynamsoft-license dynamsoft-capture-vision-router dynamsoft-utility dynamsoft-camera-enhancer dynamsoft-barcode-reader
scripts.easyPublish: npm run update:dev && npm run build && npm publish
